bottlenecks.name: High-Voltage Substation Transformers
bottlenecks.impact: Data centers cannot connect new 100MW+ capacity to the grid without years-long advance transformer orders.

bottlenecks.name: Regional Utility Interconnect Study Queues
bottlenecks.impact: PJM, ERCOT, and CAISO transmission interconnect backlogs block greenfield data center builds.

bottlenecks.name: TSMC CoWoS Packaging Allocation
bottlenecks.impact: Limits total worldwide volume production of NVIDIA B200, H200, and Google TPU dies.

bottlenecks.name: HBM3e / HBM4 High Bandwidth Memory
bottlenecks.impact: Extreme 12-layer wafer stacking yields dictate GPU delivery schedules and memory pricing power.

bottlenecks.name: 800G / 1.6T Optical Transceivers & DSPs
bottlenecks.impact: Dense GPU clusters require 3x-5x more optical transceivers than traditional cloud servers.

bottlenecks.name: Test-Time Reasoning Compute & RLHF Data
bottlenecks.impact: Shifts compute spend from one-off pre-training to infinite test-time inference reasoning tokens and verified reward data pipelines.

bottlenecks.name: Enterprise Agent Governance & Hallucination Guardrails
bottlenecks.impact: Strict SOC2, HIPAA, data lineage, and non-deterministic agent guardrails limit production rollout velocity of autonomous enterprise agents.
